name: bb
tagline: The agent IDE that builds itself
description: bb is an agentic IDE that can orchestrate multiple coding agents and let them control bb itself. Every surface — the desktop app, web app, CLI, and HTTP API — is a first-class way to drive it, and work runs in threads you can follow live, steer at any point, or hand off to another agent. Because the project is self-hosting by design, the coding agent literally drives its own development.
highlights: Orchestrates multiple coding agents together and lets them drive bb programmatically
First-class desktop app, web app, CLI, and HTTP API surfaces
Live, steerable work threads that can be handed off between agents
Self-hosting IDE where the coding agent builds itself
curatorNote: A self-modifying IDE concept that gained real traction in the window — listed on GitTrend as underrated despite strong engagement.
